descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B18 · P1 · 已知

很多时间和日期按设备时钟算，没有用服务器时间（违反 UAT 3.8）：「NEW TODAY」、入院日期、体征日期、任务完成时间、转录日期都跟着手机走；手机慢两天时停药被打成两天前，下次清理就把这个药删了

票：TFA-92584 ready for qa（UAT 3.8） · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地

注：根因已知（Daniela 10-03 提过要用服务器时间）；删药、掉标签、草稿恢复错这几个症状是新的

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-01/S08, TC-10/S22, TC-12/S23, TC-19/S19, TC-22/S23, TC-25/S24a, EFS/S28, TC-16/S25

思路 / Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S13b 「浏览器时钟差 2 天，或者在很远的时区，存的入院日期、住院第几天和徽章都一样」 A browser clock 2 days off, or a far time zone, stores the same admit date, hospital day and badge

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U11 'Day 2' and the Follow-up rule follow the server clock, not the device clock. A device set to the wrong date shows the same state (3.8).（UAT 3.8）
  • U7 A scan never invents an MRN, room or name. A field the photo did not have is left blank and flagged.（UAT TC-02；TFA-92580 AC 6；TFA-92580 How it works 5；UAT 3.4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U9 Runs and passes in both contexts: the Hospital capture (camera icon) and the Nursing Home 'Scan Resident List' (3.3).（UAT 3.3；TFA-92580 How it works 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Local stack only, never dev or prod. Three fresh physicians. scan-probe runs the same mocked scans (the h-day1-clean rows, which have no admit-date or hospital-day column, and the n-day1-clean rows) in three runs: the real clock; …

When Each run scans and adds all rows in Hospital and in Nursing Home, then reads the list cards and the stored rows

Then All three runs store the same admit date (or leave it blank; Q13), show the same hospital day or visit number and the same Follow-up badge, and show the same age for a DOB-only resident

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：scan-probe compares the three runs' backend rows (rounding:list / snf:list: admitDate, dayNum, encType, age) and the card text. Any difference is a Fail. The day roll by device clock is known: TFA-92584. A device-dated admitDate (buildScannedPatient uses new Date()) is reported alongside it. A real phone set to the wrong date is the manual item in spec.manual

在哪跑：本地 probes（多端探针）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S13b 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-02.matrix.json 里的编号；字母后缀 = 一个用例拆成了几条），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：0 条。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane probes。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本（PW (page.clock and timezoneId, mocked scan)） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：probes。

UAT item: TC-02 Patient List Capture · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-02/S13b

A browser clock 2 days off, or a far time zone, stores the same admit date, hospital day and badge

Tickets: TFA-92580 Patient List Capture (Scan Census OCR + manual add) (rejected by qa)

本地新 lane probes：probes/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题；另有一部分是已知缺口））。

怎么测（probes/plan.json，automatable: yes）：scan-probe: three fresh physicians scan the same mocked rows (h-day1-clean, n-day1-clean) under the real clock, page.clock.setFixedTime(now + 2 d), and timezoneId Pacific/Kiritimati; compare rounding:list / snf:list fields (admitDate, dayNum, encType, age) and card text (random NH auto-MRN masked). [Review 2026-10-14] Time-zone leg pins the device clock to 11:00 UTC (before 10:00 UTC) so the UTC+14 date differs from UTC / Tokyo; a pinned-clock Tokyo control leg isolates the time zone from the pin. — Mocked rows at the socket + page.clock; real phone with wrong date stays manual (spec.manual).

Detail:

Re-checked after review 2026-10-14 (18:00 JST runs: fix-*.json). Real clock vs page.clock +2 d vs Pacific/Kiritimati with the device clock pinned to 11:00 UTC (UTC+14 date Oct 15 while UTC and Tokyo are Oct 14), plus a control with the same pinned clock in Tokyo. Hospital: real and control store admitDate 'Oct 14' with the 'NEW TODAY' badge; +2 d stores 'Oct 16' and Kiritimati 'Oct 15', both without the badge. NH rows identical in all runs (random auto-MRN masked). The control equals the real run, so the Kiritimati difference comes from the time zone, not the pinned clock. Side finding: with the device clock 2 days ahead an existing valid session is shown the sign-in screen at once (re-sign-in on that device works). Real phone with a wrong date stays manual (spec.manual).

产品问题：Known TFA-92584 (day logic by device clock) plus a device-dated admitDate: a physician whose phone date is 2 days ahead scans a census and every patient is stored as admitted 'Oct 16'; a physician whose phone is in a far-east time zone (UTC+14) where it is already tomorrow stores 'Oct 15'; in both cases without the 'New today' badge, while a colleague on a correct clock in Tokyo sees 'Oct 14' / New today. Breaks TC-02 S13b and ground rule 3.8.

已知缺口（known）：TFA-92584

证据：附了 5 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — The given says local stack only, never dev or prod.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
